title: Private land, public benefits: Conservation covenants and easements aiding global biodiversity targets
title_zh: 私有土地，公共福祉：保护契约与地役权助力全球生物多样性目标
title_primary: 私有土地，公共福祉：保护契约与地役权助力全球生物多样性目标
title_secondary: Private land, public benefits: Conservation covenants and easements aiding global biodiversity targets
authors: Benjamin J. Richardson, Sarah Brugler, Phillipa C. McCormack, James A. Fitzsimons
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Conservation covenants are an innovative legal mechanism that modify private property rights to promote biodiversity benefits. Their use is increasing as governments encourage private land conservation to help meet national and global biodiversity goals, such as the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. However, existing use of covenants from a variety of countries, including Australia, New Zealand and the United States, highlights some limitations. There is limited explicit accommodation of changing circumstances such as climate impacts; insufficient support to landowners and a need for increased environmental monitoring and compliance oversight. Several actions could be taken to ameliorate these and other law-related impediments, including improved reciprocity between parties to covenants, designing covenants with greater flexibility, and improving integrity mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 保护契约是一种创新的法律机制，通过调整私人财产权以促进生物多样性效益。随着政府鼓励私人土地保护以助力实现国家和全球生物多样性目标，如昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架，其应用日益增多。然而，来自澳大利亚、新西兰和美国等多个国家的现有契约使用情况揭示了若干局限性。这些包括对气候变化影响等变化情况的明确适应不足；对土地所有者的支持不够，以及需要加强环境监测和合规监督。为缓解这些及其他法律相关障碍，可采取多项措施，包括增强契约双方间的互惠性，设计更具灵活性的契约，以及完善诚信机制。

title: Dynamic Effects of Trade
title_zh: 贸易的动态效应
title_primary: 贸易的动态效应
title_secondary: Dynamic Effects of Trade
authors: Benny Kleinman, Ernest Liu, Stephen J. Redding
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The existence of aggregate welfare gains from trade is one of the classic insights from international economics. However, these conventional welfare gains are static, in the sense that they take existing factor supplies and production technologies at a point in time as given. Recent research has highlighted dynamic effects of trade through endogenous factor accumulation and technological innovation over time, although there remains less consensus about the quantitative magnitude of these dynamic effects than about their static counterparts. Key insights from this research are that short-run and long-run responses to trade liberalization differ; capital accumulation amplifies the impact of international trade shocks; trade can facilitate technology adoption and the diffusion of ideas by changing the composition of suppliers; effects on lifetime welfare differ substantially from those on steady-state welfare, once transition dynamics are taken into account; and market failures can either magnify the overall welfare gains from trade or rationalize activist trade and industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 贸易带来的总体福利增益的存在是国际经济学中的经典洞见之一。然而，这些传统福利增益是静态的，即它们假定某一时点的要素供给和生产技术为既定。近期研究强调了贸易通过内生要素积累和技术创新随时间产生的动态效应，尽管对于这些动态效应的量化规模，共识程度不如静态对应效应。该研究的关键洞见包括：贸易自由化的短期与长期反应存在差异；资本积累放大了国际贸易冲击的影响；贸易通过改变供应商构成，能促进技术采纳和思想传播；一旦考虑转型动态，对终身福利的影响与对稳态福利的影响大相径庭；市场失灵既可能放大贸易带来的总体福利增益，也可能为积极的贸易和产业政策提供合理性依据。

title: Born Different: Entrepreneurship through Inventor Mobility, Innovation, and Growth
title_zh: 天生不同：发明家流动、创业、创新与增长
title_primary: 天生不同：发明家流动、创业、创新与增长
title_secondary: Born Different: Entrepreneurship through Inventor Mobility, Innovation, and Growth
authors: Salomé Baslandze, Ia Vardishvili
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Large productivity differences across firms reflect substantial ex-ante heterogeneity at entry, yet the origins of this heterogeneity remain poorly understood. This paper shows that innovating spinouts—firms formed by inventors leaving incumbent innovators—are a key endogenous source of high-growth entrepreneurship and aggregate productivity growth. Using inventor mobility in patent data, we document that spinouts systematically outperform other entrants throughout their life cycle, their performance is strongly linked to parent-firm technological strength, and their formation temporarily depresses parent-firm innovation. We develop a Schumpeterian growth model that endogenizes spinout formation and the fundamental tradeoff between knowledge diffusion, creative destruction, and appropriability. Closely disciplined by rich microlevel data, the model implies that spinouts account for a disproportionate share of high-growth firms and nearly forty percent of aggregate productivity growth, but that inventor departures also impose sizable costs on incumbents, generating a fundamental policy tradeoff. Policy counterfactuals show that relaxing non-compete restrictions raises aggregate growth and welfare and amplifies the effectiveness of entry subsidies.
abstract_zh: 企业间巨大的生产率差异反映了进入时显著的先验异质性，然而这种异质性的根源至今仍知之甚少。本文表明，创新型衍生企业——即由离开在位创新企业的发明家所创立的企业——是高增长创业和总体生产率增长的一个关键内生来源。利用专利数据中的发明家流动性，我们记录了衍生企业在整个生命周期中系统性地优于其他进入者，其绩效与母体企业的技术实力密切相关，且其形成会暂时抑制母体企业的创新活动。我们构建了一个熊彼特增长模型，将衍生企业的形成以及知识扩散、创造性破坏与可占有性之间的根本权衡内生化。该模型受到丰富微观数据的严格约束，其结果表明，衍生企业在高增长企业中占据不成比例的份额，并贡献了总体生产率增长的近百分之四十，但发明家的离职也给在位企业带来了可观成本，从而产生根本性的政策权衡。政策反事实分析表明，放宽竞业限制条款会提高总体增长和福利，并增强进入补贴的有效性。

title: Shifts in Frontline Healthcare Services and Rural Access to Care
title_zh: 一线医疗服务转变与农村就医可及性
title_primary: 一线医疗服务转变与农村就医可及性
title_secondary: Shifts in Frontline Healthcare Services and Rural Access to Care
authors: Van Sandt, Anders, Carpenter, Craig, Gruber, Anja, Loveridge, Scott
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Over the past four decades, the U.S. healthcare system has shifted from hospital-based care toward outpatient and community-based services, fundamentally changing where and how frontline care is delivered. Using establishment-level data from the Longitudinal Business Database and American Community Survey (1980–2023), we examine trends across eight healthcare industries. While most frontline services expanded, physician offices declined sharply, particularly in rural areas, alongside a broader shift toward larger, multi-establishment firms. Rural healthcare is not simply declining but being reconfigured into a different mix of services, with greater reliance on outsourced care, especially for capital-intensive diagnostics. Employment-based access remains lower in non-metro counties across several frontline services. Provider presence is closely tied to payer mix, though these relationships are weaker in rural areas where structural constraints appear more binding. These patterns suggest the transition to outpatient care has redistributed access unevenly, contributing to growing geographic disparities and spatial mismatches in healthcare access.
abstract_zh: 过去四十年间，美国医疗体系已从以医院为中心的照护模式转向门诊及社区基础服务，从根本上改变了前线医疗服务提供的地点与方式。利用纵向商业数据库及美国社区调查（1980-2023年）中的机构层面数据，我们考察了八个医疗行业的趋势。尽管大多数前线服务有所扩展，但医生诊所在农村地区尤其急剧缩减，同时伴随着向更大规模、多机构企业的整体转变。农村医疗并非简单衰退，而是被重构为不同的服务组合，更加依赖外包服务，尤其是资本密集型诊断服务。在多个前线服务领域，非都市县的就业基础获取渠道仍然较低。服务提供者的存在与支付方结构密切相关，但在农村地区，这些关系较弱，结构性约束似乎更具束缚力。这些模式表明，向门诊照护的转型不均衡地重新分配了获取渠道，加剧了医疗获取方面的地理差异与空间错配。

title: Sovereign vs. Corporate Debt and Default: More Similar Than You Think
title_zh: 主权债务与企业债务及违约：相似性远超想象
title_primary: 主权债务与企业债务及违约：相似性远超想象
title_secondary: Sovereign vs. Corporate Debt and Default: More Similar Than You Think
authors: Gopinath, Gita, Meyer, Josefin, Reinhart, Carmen, Trebesch, Christoph, Reinhart, Carmen M.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Theory suggests that corporate and sovereign bonds are fundamentally different, also because sovereign debt has no bankruptcy mechanism and is hard to enforce. We show empirically that the two assets are more similar than you think, at least when it comes to high-yield bonds over the past 20 years. We use rich new data to compare high-yield US corporate ("junkâ€ ) bonds to high-yield emerging market sovereign bonds 2002-2021. Investor experiences in these two asset classes were surprisingly aligned, with (i) similar average excess returns, (ii) similar average risk-return patterns (Sharpe ratios), (iii) similar default frequency, and (iv) comparable haircuts. A notable difference is that the average default duration is higher for sovereigns. Moreover, the two markets co-move differently with domestic and global factors. US "junkâ€ bond yields are more closely linked to US market conditions such as US stock returns, US stock price volatility (VIX), or US monetary policy.
abstract_zh: 理论认为，公司债券与主权债券存在根本差异，部分原因在于主权债务缺乏破产机制且难以执行。我们通过实证研究发现，这两种资产实际上比人们想象的更为相似，至少在过去20年的高收益债券领域如此。我们利用丰富的新数据，对2002年至2021年间美国高收益公司债券（即“垃圾”债券）与新兴市场高收益主权债券进行了比较。投资者在这两类资产中的体验惊人地一致，表现为：（一）相似的平均超额回报率，（二）相似的平均风险-回报特征（夏普比率），（三）相似的违约频率，以及（四）可比的减记幅度。一个显著差异在于，主权债券的平均违约持续时间更长。此外，这两个市场与国内及全球因素的联动性不同。美国“垃圾”债券收益率与美国市场状况，如美国股票回报率、美国股市波动率（VIX）或美国货币政策，关联更为紧密。

title: The impact of property tax incentives on residential investment
title_zh: 房产税激励对住宅投资的影响
title_primary: 房产税激励对住宅投资的影响
title_secondary: The impact of property tax incentives on residential investment
authors: Baldomero-Quintana, Luis, Singh, Divya
official: 官方在线 2026-08-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We estimate the short- and long-run impacts of a property tax reform in New York City (NYC) on the construction of new rental apartments. The reform, announced in 2006 and implemented in 2008, imposed new requirements to claim a property tax exemption. To estimate the short-run impacts, we use the delay between the announcement and the implementation of the reform to estimate the excess housing starts in response to a future property tax increase. We find that the tax reform induced excess building starts of 10,735 new rental units, equivalent to 1% of the 2007 rental housing stock. To estimate the long-run impacts, we use a difference-in-differences (DiD) strategy comparing census tracts in regions where the new requirements to obtain the tax exemption were stringent vs. tracts in regions where the new requirements were lenient. We find that the tracts with new strict requirements built 0.58 to 0.81 (22.25 to 22.75) more new buildings (new rental units) relative to the comparison group census tracts. These estimates represent 0.3x to 0.4x (2.4x to 2.5x) the median number of new buildings (rental units) per census tract per year in the 2003–15 sample period. Our findings yield two conclusions. First, a property tax reform can increase residential investment in the long run, even if a grace period produces a temporal boom and bust in construction. Second, local tax policy is a key determinant of housing supply in cities with high density and land scarcity.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了纽约市房产税改革对新建租赁公寓的短期与长期影响。该改革于2006年宣布，2008年实施，对申请房产税豁免提出了新要求。为估算短期影响，我们利用改革宣布与实施之间的延迟期，评估了因未来房产税增加而引发的超额住房开工量。研究发现，税收改革促使新增开工10，735套租赁住房单元，相当于2007年租赁住房存量的1%。为估算长期影响，我们采用双重差分策略，比较了获得税收豁免新要求严格与宽松地区的普查区。结果显示，新要求严格地区的普查区相对于对照组，多建设了0.58至0.81栋新建筑（或22.25至22.75套新租赁单元）。这些估计值相当于2003-2015年样本期间每个普查区每年新建建筑（租赁单元）中位数的0.3至0.4倍（2.4至2.5倍）。我们的发现得出两点结论：第一，即使宽限期导致建筑活动出现暂时繁荣与萧条，房产税改革仍能在长期内增加住宅投资；第二，在人口密集、土地稀缺的城市中，地方税收政策是住房供应的关键决定因素。

title: The Paris Agreement ten years later: Navigating climate uncertainty and tipping points
title_zh: 《巴黎协定》十年后：应对气候不确定性与临界点
title_primary: 《巴黎协定》十年后：应对气候不确定性与临界点
title_secondary: The Paris Agreement ten years later: Navigating climate uncertainty and tipping points
authors: Broeders, Dirk & Mongelli, Francesco Paolo
official: 官方在线 2026-01-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The climate crisis is an urgent, human-driven systemic challenge whose impacts are unfolding through increasingly frequent and severe extreme events. Although the 2015 Paris Agreement advanced global climate governance, implementation remains insufficient to limit warming to well below 2 °C and pursue 1.5 °C. Accelerating risks, interacting crises and potential tipping points suggest that climate change could become unmanageable if current GHGs emissions trajectories persist. This paper makes three contributions. First, it examines why we are failing to act decisively, highlighting a persistent awareness gap, competing priorities and weak political incentives for ambitious climate action. Second, it draws on NGFS climate-policy scenarios, the climate policy trilemma and a precautionary approach to clarify policymaking trade-offs under uncertainty. Third, it reviews policy, financial and technological levers to accelerate a just green transition. A new climate policy paradigm is needed: a systemic, precautionary, adaptive and incentive-compatible framework that can “tilt the odds” away from irreversible climate damage, even when probabilities are poorly known. JEL Classification: D81, E61, D62, Q54
abstract_zh: 气候危机是由人类活动驱动的系统性紧迫挑战，其影响正通过日益频繁和严重的极端事件显现。尽管2015年《巴黎协定》推动了全球气候治理，但当前实施力度仍不足以将升温控制在远低于2°C并力争1.5°C的目标范围内。风险加速累积、危机交互作用及潜在临界点表明，若当前温室气体排放轨迹持续，气候变化可能变得难以管控。本文做出三项贡献：第一，剖析人类未能果断行动的原因，揭示持续存在的认知差距、相互冲突的优先事项以及缺乏推动雄心气候行动的强有力政治激励；第二，借鉴NGFS气候政策情景、气候政策三难困境及预防性原则，阐明不确定性下的政策制定权衡；第三，梳理加速公正绿色转型的政策、金融与技术杠杆。研究提出需要构建新型气候政策范式——一个系统性、预防性、适应性且激励相容的框架，即便在概率认知不充分的情况下，也能"扭转概率"以避免不可逆的气候损害。JEL分类号：D81, E61, D62, Q54

title: Who drives inequality?
title_zh: 谁在驱动不平等？
title_primary: 谁在驱动不平等？
title_secondary: Who drives inequality?
authors: Domenico Moramarco, Olivier Sterck
official: 官方在线 2026-07-21 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Which countries drive global inequality? Which states drive US inequality? We characterize the class of inequality measures that can answer these questions, permitting both an additive decomposition by subgroup and a multiplicative decomposition into within- and between-group components. Its central measure is simply the expected ratio of incomes between two randomly selected individuals. We show that global inequality fell since 1990, driven by declining disparities between countries. Inequality is primarily driven by large middle-income countries (India, China) and poor countries (Democratic Republic of Congo, Ethiopia). In the US, rising inequality is explained by widening gaps within states, while between-state inequality remains limited.
abstract_zh: 哪些国家推动了全球不平等？哪些州推动了美国不平等？我们刻画了能够回答这些问题的不平等度量类别，这类度量既允许按子群进行加性分解，也允许分解为组内和组间成分的乘性结构。其核心度量指标简化为随机选取两个个体收入比值的期望值。研究表明，自1990年以来，全球不平等程度有所下降，这主要源于国家间差距的缩小。不平等的主要驱动因素来自大型中等收入国家（印度、中国）和贫困国家（刚果民主共和国、埃塞俄比亚）。在美国，不平等加剧的原因在于各州内部差距的扩大，而州际不平等程度仍然有限。

title: Racial Promotion Gaps
title_zh: 种族晋升差距
title_primary: 种族晋升差距
title_secondary: Racial Promotion Gaps
authors: Hegde, Deepak, Ljungqvist, Alexander, Raj, Manav
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We study racial disparities in promotions in a setting in which promotions are formulaic: the US patent office. Using detailed administrative data that allow us to observe who is eligible for promotion when, we document that Black patent examiners experience delays in promotions they are entitled to, slowing their climb to the top of the career ladder by a year and reducing career earnings by 2.9%. Institutional features rule out statistical discrimination with accurate priors. Slow promotions even under Black supervisors argue against taste-based animus. Instead, the patterns fit models of belief-based discrimination.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了在晋升流程高度程式化的情境——美国专利局——中存在的种族晋升差异。利用详尽的行政数据，我们得以观察特定时间点符合晋升条件的群体，发现黑人专利审查员在应得晋升中遭遇延迟，导致其职业阶梯顶端晋升速度放缓一年，职业生涯收入减少2.9%。制度特征排除了基于准确先验信息的统计性歧视。即使在黑人主管领导下仍存在晋升缓慢现象，这否定了基于偏好的歧视解释。相反，这些模式符合基于信念的歧视模型。

title: Shaping Institutions
title_zh: 塑造制度
title_primary: 塑造制度
title_secondary: Shaping Institutions
authors: Fuchs, William, Fukuda, Satoshi
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Applied Economics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We propose a simple model of the evolution of institutional strength, where leaders' actions have a persistent effect by shaping the norms of the institutions they lead. This leads to different long-run behaviors even for institutions with the same formal rules. The early history of leaders plays a crucial role in determining which outcome prevails. Every period, a leader decides to respect or abuse their position. Respect strengthens the institutions; abuse weakens them. Leader's type and institutional strength determine both the benefit/cost of abusing the position and the replacement probability. We elucidate democratic backsliding and corporate-board capturing.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个关于制度强度演化的简单模型，其中领导者的行为通过塑造其领导机构的规范而产生持久影响。即使正式规则相同的制度，也会因此产生不同的长期行为。领导者的早期经历在决定最终结果中起着关键作用。每个时期，领导者都会决定是尊重还是滥用其职位。尊重会强化制度，滥用则会削弱制度。领导者的类型和制度强度共同决定了滥用职位的收益/成本以及被替换的概率。我们阐释了民主倒退和公司董事会俘获现象。

title: The Dynamics of Global Sourcing

authors: Hoang, Trang
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper studies a model of heterogeneous importers that incorporates static cross-country interdependence and dynamic dependence in firmlevel decisions. Using data on Chinese importers between 2000–2006, I find that source countries are complementary, i.e., the benefit of importing from one country increases as a firm imports from more countries. Accounting for this complementarity, I estimate the sunk costs of importing, which make establishing relationships with new suppliers costlier than maintaining existing ones. I illustrate how the sunk cost estimates depend on cross-country interdependence and model specifications, such as the inclusion of export decisions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个异质性进口商模型，该模型融合了企业层面决策的静态跨国相互依赖性与动态依赖性。基于2000-2006年中国进口商数据，研究发现来源国之间存在互补性，即企业从一国进口的收益会随其进口来源国数量的增加而提升。在考虑这种互补性的基础上，本文估算了进口的沉没成本——建立新供应商关系的成本高于维持现有关系的成本。研究进一步揭示了沉没成本估算如何受跨国相互依赖性与模型设定（如是否纳入出口决策）的影响。

title: Friends or Neighbors? Advice Networks, Geographic Proximity, and the Transmission of Health Knowledge
title_zh: 朋友还是邻居？建议网络、地理邻近性与健康知识的传播
title_primary: 朋友还是邻居？建议网络、地理邻近性与健康知识的传播
title_secondary: Friends or Neighbors? Advice Networks, Geographic Proximity, and the Transmission of Health Knowledge
authors: Yves Zenou, Nicholas Christakis, Michael Vlassopoulos
official: 官方在线 2026-07-01 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Public-health interventions often aspire to generate spillovers beyond the households they directly reach, but identifying who is exposed to whom within communities is challenging. Researchers frequently approximate social exposure using geographic proximity, even though the individuals who transmit health advice need not be nearby. We study this issue by conducting secondary analysis of a randomized maternal and child health counseling intervention in rural Honduras with geocoded households and mapped social networks. At our main 50-meter radius, geographic proximity captures only 30.8% of health-advice ties, while only 3.7% of geographically proximate household pairs are connected by advice-giving. The choice of exposure mapping matters for what the analysis detects. Exposure mappings based solely on geographic proximity yield a precise zero effect on diarrhea knowledge. By contrast, exposure through advice ties beyond 50 meters increases diarrhea knowledge, and the effect is statistically distinguishable from exposure through nearby non-advice contacts. The evidence suggests that simple, actionable illness-management knowledge diffuses through advice relationships that geographic proximity alone fails to capture. Reported diarrhea, indicating whether the respondent or any child had diarrhea in the previous four weeks, also increases with advice exposure outside 50m, consistent with greater recognition, recall, or reporting rather than higher underlying morbidity. We find no corresponding effects for respiratory knowledge or reported respiratory illness. Our results show that using geographic proximity as a proxy for social exposure can mask important channels of information transmission and could lead researchers to miss meaningful spillover effects.
abstract_zh: 公共卫生干预措施往往期望在直接覆盖的家庭之外产生溢出效应，但识别社区内谁与谁接触具有挑战性。研究人员常以地理邻近性近似衡量社会接触，尽管传播健康建议的个体未必相邻。我们通过对洪都拉斯农村地区一项随机母婴健康咨询干预进行二次分析来研究这一问题，该干预包含地理编码家庭和映射社会网络数据。在主要50米半径范围内，地理邻近性仅捕捉到30.8%的健康建议联系，而仅有3.7%的地理邻近家庭对存在建议传递关系。暴露映射的选择会影响分析结果。仅基于地理邻近性的暴露映射显示对腹泻知识的影响精确为零。相反，通过50米外建议联系产生的暴露能提升腹泻知识，其效应在统计上显著区别于邻近非建议接触的暴露。证据表明，简单可行的疾病管理知识通过建议关系传播，而单纯地理邻近性无法捕捉这种关系。报告腹泻（反映受访者或任何儿童在过去四周内是否出现腹泻）也随50米外建议暴露增加而增加，这与更高的认知、回忆或报告率一致，而非潜在发病率上升。我们未发现呼吸系统知识或报告呼吸系统疾病存在相应效应。研究结果表明，将地理邻近性作为社会接触的代理变量可能掩盖重要的信息传播渠道，并导致研究者遗漏有意义的溢出效应。

title: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
title_zh: 动态限额与交易市场中的交易摩擦
title_primary: 动态限额与交易市场中的交易摩擦
title_secondary: Trading Frictions in Dynamic Cap-and-Trade Markets
authors: Nicola Borri, Yukun Liu, Aleh Tsyvinski, Xi Wu
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a dynamic stochastic model of markets with an externality and multiple trading frictions, and cap-and-trade as the leading application. Slow participation, limited intermediation, and heterogeneous information interact in equilibrium: agents choose costly market access, access determines residual compliance demand, intermediary constraints translate residual demand into a surrender-month premium, and the premium feeds back into access incentives. These interactions shape how effectively the market corrects the externality. We characterize access choices in closed form, prove that the equilibrium premium is unique, and show that endogenous access dampens the response to each friction in isolation, while the interaction of multiple frictions is non-additive and can amplify the price response. We quantify the model using 2.7 million EU ETS registry transactions and compliance records from 2005–2021. About 40% of operators do not trade annually, purchases concentrate in April when returns are systematically high, and operator flow predicts future returns.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含外部性与多重交易摩擦的市场动态随机模型，并以限额与交易制度作为主要应用场景。缓慢参与、有限中介与异质信息在均衡中相互作用：代理人选择成本高昂的市场准入，准入决定剩余合规需求，中介约束将剩余需求转化为交割月溢价，而溢价又反馈至准入激励。这些相互作用塑造了市场纠正外部性的效率。我们以闭式解刻画准入选择，证明均衡溢价的唯一性，并表明内生准入会削弱单一摩擦的价格响应，而多重摩擦的交互作用具有非加总性，可能放大价格效应。基于2005-2021年间270万条欧盟排放交易体系（EU ETS）登记交易与合规记录进行量化分析发现：约40%的运营商未进行年度交易，购买集中在回报率系统性偏高的四月，且运营商资金流向可预测未来收益。

title: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
title_zh: 激励、证据与对官僚的提醒：克服政策推广的障碍
title_primary: 激励、证据与对官僚的提醒：克服政策推广的障碍
title_secondary: Incentives, Evidence, and Reminders for Bureaucrats: Overcoming Barriers to Policy Scale Up
authors: Patrick Agte, Daniel R. Morales, Christopher Neilson, Sebastián Otero, Gautam Rao
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Scaling up effective policies often requires the attention of frontline bureaucrats with many competing responsibilities. Even when policymakers adopt effective programs, implementation may not follow. In a nationwide experiment in the Dominican Republic, we test interventions to increase school principals' implementation of an educational program proven effective in a previous RCT. Only 37% of control schools verifiably implemented the intervention when ordered to by the Ministry of Education, compared with 83% in the original trial. Implementation was no higher among schools that previously implemented the program in the RCT, suggesting that fixed costs of adoption do not explain non-adoption. We find precise null effects of sharing research evidence, providing modest financial incentives, or offering implementation assistance to principals. In contrast, additional reminder calls increased implementation by 20 percentage points. A second experiment targeting a different mandated program yields the same pattern: reminders produce large effects, while monitoring messages have smaller effects. Our findings point to limited attention among bureaucrats as an important barrier to scaling policies.
abstract_zh: 扩大有效政策的实施规模，往往需要一线行政人员投入精力，而他们通常身兼多项职责。即使政策制定者采纳了有效的项目，执行也可能无法跟进。在多米尼加共和国的一项全国性实验中，我们测试了旨在提高校长执行一项经先前随机对照试验（RCT）证明有效的教育项目的干预措施。当教育部下令实施时，对照组学校中仅有37%可验证地执行了该干预措施，而原始试验中这一比例为83%。在先前RCT中已执行该项目的学校中，实施率并未更高，这表明采纳的固定成本并不能解释未采纳现象。我们发现，分享研究证据、提供适度经济激励或向校长提供实施支持均产生精确的零效应。相比之下，额外的提醒电话使实施率提高了20个百分点。针对另一项强制性项目的第二项实验得出了相同模式：提醒产生显著效果，而监控信息的效果较小。我们的研究结果表明，行政人员注意力有限是政策规模化推广的重要障碍。

authors: Sarah R. Cohodes, Astrid C. Pineda
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The charter school movement encompasses many school models. In Massachusetts in the 2010s, the site of our study, urban charter schools primarily used “No Excuses” practices, whereas nonurban charters had greater model variety. Using randomized admissions lotteries, we estimate the impact of charter schools by locality on college preparation, enrollment, and graduation. Urban charter schools boost all of these outcomes. Nonurban charter schools raise college enrollment and graduation despite reducing state test scores and AP enrollment. Notably, the nonurban charter college graduation edge is more than twice as large as that from urban charter attendance. (JEL H75, I21, I23, I28)
abstract_zh: 特许学校运动包含多种学校模式。在我们研究的马萨诸塞州，2010年代的城市特许学校主要采用"零容忍"实践，而非城市特许学校的模式则更加多样化。利用随机录取抽签机制，我们估算了不同地区特许学校对大学准备、入学及毕业的影响。城市特许学校提升了所有这些指标。非城市特许学校尽管降低了州统考成绩和AP课程注册率，却提高了大学入学率和毕业率。值得注意的是，非城市特许学校带来的大学毕业生优势是城市特许学校的两倍以上。（JEL H75, I21, I23, I28）

title: Outcomes of a Public Program to Support Sustainable Livestock Farming: Evidence From Uruguay
title_zh: 乌拉圭可持续畜牧业公共支持计划的效果：来自实证研究的证据
title_primary: 乌拉圭可持续畜牧业公共支持计划的效果：来自实证研究的证据
title_secondary: Outcomes of a Public Program to Support Sustainable Livestock Farming: Evidence From Uruguay
authors: Emilio Aguirre, Juan Baraldo, Marcelo Caffera, Hugo Laguna
official: 官方在线 2026-05-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: As global demand for beef increases, balancing livestock productivity with environmental sustainability has become a policy priority. In response, Uruguay implemented the Sustainable Family Production Programme (PFIS) between 2015 and 2017, providing targeted support for small and medium‐sized cattle farmers to invest in productivity‐enhancing and climate‐adaptive technologies. This study provides the first causal evaluation of a national programme designed to promote these dual objectives in the cattle sector. Using a regression discontinuity design based on a strict eligibility threshold and panel data from 2015 to 2020, we evaluate the programme's effect on five dimensions: (i) the adoption of technology and practices, (ii) engagement in producer organisations, (iii) reported cattle health problems, (iv) beef production per hectare, and (v) greenhouse gas emissions intensity. The intervention significantly increased the application of reproductive and herd management practices, specifically early weaning, controlled mating, and ovarian activity diagnosis, without generating shifts in the other measured outcomes by the 2020 horizon. These results highlight both the potential and the limitations of integrated technology transfer programmes in promoting sustainable intensification of extensive livestock systems. They also suggest the need for longer‐term evaluations to capture potential effects on productivity and emissions that may emerge as these technologies, particularly reproductive ones, influence aggregate outcomes.
abstract_zh: 随着全球牛肉需求增长，平衡畜牧业生产力与环境可持续性已成为政策重点。为此，乌拉圭于2015年至2017年间实施了可持续家庭生产计划（PFIS），为中小型养牛户提供针对性支持，以投资于提升生产力和气候适应性技术。本研究首次对旨在促进养牛业双重目标的国家级计划进行因果评估。基于严格资格门槛的断点回归设计及2015-2020年面板数据，我们从五个维度评估该计划的效果：（i）技术与实践采纳率；（ii）生产者组织参与度；（iii）报告牛群健康问题；（iv）每公顷牛肉产量；（v）温室气体排放强度。该干预措施显著提高了繁殖与畜群管理实践的应用率，具体表现为早期断奶、控制配种及卵巢活动诊断，但截至2020年，其他衡量指标未发生显著变化。这些结果既揭示了综合性技术推广计划在促进粗放型畜牧系统可持续集约化方面的潜力，也凸显了其局限性。同时表明，随着这些技术（尤其是繁殖技术）对总体产出产生影响，需开展更长期评估以捕捉其对生产力和排放的潜在效应。

title: A stakeholder-integrated land-use model for nature conservation in metropolitan areas: The case of the Randstad, Netherlands
title_zh: 面向大都市区自然保护的整合利益相关者土地利用模型：以荷兰兰斯塔德为例
title_primary: 面向大都市区自然保护的整合利益相关者土地利用模型：以荷兰兰斯塔德为例
title_secondary: A stakeholder-integrated land-use model for nature conservation in metropolitan areas: The case of the Randstad, Netherlands
authors: Yinuo Zhou, Shahryar Sarabi, Bin Zhang, Qi Han
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-26 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Accurate understanding and modelling of complex nature land dynamics is essential for effective nature conservation and land-use planning, particularly in and around metropolitan areas where diverse land-use demands compete for limited space. However, existing modelling frameworks often overlook stakeholder interactions by relying solely on spatial drivers such as land suitability, and tend to oversimplify land-use dynamics by focusing on a single land-use type, ignoring the competing pressures from other land uses. To address this gap, this study proposes a stakeholder-integrated land-use competition (SI-LUC) model that integrates stakeholder interactions, defined by decision-making and negotiation processes, into a multi-type land-use competition framework. The model was applied to simulate nature land dynamics in the Randstad metropolitan area from 2012 to 2023. Results show that SI-LUC improves simulation performance compared to a widely used conventional model, achieving around 5% increase in the global Figure of Merit (FoM). Moreover, the sensitivity analysis confirms the effectiveness of stakeholder-related parameters in SI-LUC, such as negotiation costs and thresholds to agree, in regulating the intensity of stakeholder interactions and shaping nature land changes. Additionally, the scenario analysis highlights the model’s potential as a virtual laboratory for testing governance strategies on nature conservation, enabling decision-makers assess the long-term effects of different nature governance approaches and facilitating a more informed, context-sensitive land-use planning in complex urban contexts.
abstract_zh: 准确理解与模拟复杂的自然土地动态对于有效的自然保护和土地利用规划至关重要，尤其是在大都市区及其周边地区，那里多样化的土地利用需求在有限空间内相互竞争。然而，现有的建模框架往往仅依赖土地适宜性等空间驱动因素，忽视了利益相关者之间的互动，并且倾向于通过聚焦单一土地利用类型来过度简化土地利用动态，忽略了其他土地利用带来的竞争压力。为弥补这一不足，本研究提出了一种利益相关者整合的土地利用竞争（SI-LUC）模型，该模型将利益相关者互动（由决策和谈判过程定义）整合到多类型土地利用竞争框架中。该模型被应用于模拟2012年至2023年间兰斯塔德大都市区的自然土地动态。结果表明，与广泛使用的传统模型相比，SI-LUC提高了模拟性能，全球品质因数（FoM）提升了约5%。此外，敏感性分析证实了SI-LUC中利益相关者相关参数的有效性，如谈判成本和达成一致的阈值，这些参数在调节利益相关者互动强度和塑造自然土地变化方面发挥作用。另外，情景分析凸显了该模型作为虚拟实验室的潜力，可用于测试自然保护治理策略，使决策者能够评估不同自然治理方法的长期影响，并促进在复杂城市背景下进行更明智、更具情境敏感性的土地利用规划。

abstract: Victoria Bateman's Economica is, above all, a great read. It is written for a general audience, and Bateman's gifts as a scholar, writer, and wit are beautifully displayed throughout. Here, she raises the widest of Minervan wings to move confidently across the centuries and the continents. Arguments are conveyed through vivid storytelling, making Economica engaging, enjoyable, pacy, fun, and quite frankly, exciting in many places. Bateman's central contribution is to explode the widely held belief that women's economic liberation was a twentieth-century achievement with its origins in enlightenment and modernity. Academic historians may know that women had economic power at times in history, but beyond the seminar room, many of the educated and successful people running large organizations today may have heard of Claudia Goldin, yet know nothing of the period before 1850 other than the word ‘patriarchy’. Bateman corrects this, telling the stories of women who possessed significant economic roles, wealth, and authority from 500 BC across the globe. In doing so, she offers readers a rethink of some familiar ideas about power, progress, and emancipation. This is a valuable intervention, and one that scholarly economic historians should take seriously, even where they might remain unconvinced by particular claims, approaches, or interpretations. Bateman's grasp of long-run global economic history is impressive and she makes connections that specialists in the field of gender may need reminding of, such as the strong link between an emerging female labour market in late medieval southern Europe and enslavement. As the chapters evolve, a pattern emerges that should be obvious to academic economic historians but is too rarely discussed or analysed. The determinant of how societies have shared economic power and productivity between men and women is a matter fundamentally of property rights. (The recurrent theme of the value of reproduction in creating and maintaining wealth is one that should be of huge interest given current intergenerational inequities). The consistent story is that throughout history, in growing or emerging economies, many women have owned and controlled property, participated in trade and production, and created wealth. However, after a period of growth, women's rights and activities always tend to be eroded rather than expanded. Economica’s narrative suggests that when the distribution of gains from economic activity becomes uncertain – during periods of technological disruption, market expansion, or structural transformation (war) – conservative forces (men and women) emerge to construct institutions that regulate, exclude, and restrict women. Law, custom, professionalization, and moral discourse turn to function as active mechanisms of economic ordering to women's exclusion and ultimately, harm. Academic readers are likely to bristle in places. Bateman's treatment of economic activity can be viewed as conflating wealth, position, agency, leadership, intellectual talent, productivity, scientific knowledge, managerial competence, and entrepreneurialism into a single category of ‘economic power’. Their conflation sometimes weakens the explanatory force of the argument. For specialists, this might be frustrating. Yet casting this off as general interest trade book risks missing a deeper thesis that runs through it. Economica suggests that women's exclusion is not just a legacy of ‘patriarchy’, but a recurring outcome of the process of institutional change that emerge from economic and technological development. If Sheilagh Ogilvie's focus has been on old institutions as exclusionary and discriminatory, the implications of Economica are that it is the new ones we also need to keep an eye on. Although Bateman seeks to make the point that societies should support female economic activity, with a 10-point manifesto for female empowerment at the end, Economica also points beyond itself. The relationship between growth, technological change, and the gendered design of economic institutions remains under-theorized. The similarities or otherwise between the institutions that emerge, whose interests they serve, and how they evolve across cycles of expansion and disruption is work still to be done. Bateman does not resolve these questions, but she places them firmly on the agenda. For that reason, and also because students will probably love it, Economica is a book that economic historians should embrace and probably put on a reading list.
abstract_zh: 维多利亚·贝特曼的《经济学》首先是一部极佳的读物。它面向普通读者撰写，贝特曼作为学者、作家和幽默大师的才华在书中处处闪耀。在此，她展开最宽广的密涅瓦之翼，自信地跨越数个世纪与各大洲。论点通过生动的叙事传达，使《经济学》引人入胜、令人愉悦、节奏明快、妙趣横生，坦率地说，在许多地方令人兴奋不已。贝特曼的核心贡献在于打破了人们广泛持有的信念，即女性的经济解放是二十世纪的成就，其根源在于启蒙与现代性。学术历史学家或许知道女性在历史上某些时期拥有经济权力，但在研讨室之外，当今许多受过教育、经营大型组织的成功人士可能听说过克劳迪娅·戈尔丁，却对1850年之前的时期一无所知，只知“父权制”一词。贝特曼纠正了这一点，讲述了从公元前500年起全球各地拥有重要经济角色、财富和权威的女性的故事。在此过程中，她为读者提供了对权力、进步和解放等一些熟悉观念的重新思考。这是一项有价值的介入，学术经济历史学家应认真对待，即使他们可能对某些具体主张、方法或解释仍持保留态度。贝特曼对长期全球经济史的把握令人印象深刻，她建立了性别领域专家可能需要提醒的联系，例如中世纪晚期南欧新兴女性劳动力市场与奴役之间的紧密关联。随着章节的推进，一种模式浮现出来，这对学术经济历史学家而言应当显而易见，却鲜少被讨论或分析。社会如何在男女之间分配经济权力和生产力的决定因素，从根本上说是产权问题。（关于再生产在创造和维持财富中的价值的反复主题，鉴于当前代际不平等问题，应引起极大关注。）一贯的故事是，纵观历史，在增长或新兴经济体中，许多女性拥有并控制财产，参与贸易和生产，创造财富。然而，在增长一段时间后，女性的权利和活动总是趋于被侵蚀而非扩展。《经济学》的叙事表明，当经济活动收益的分配变得不确定时——在技术颠覆、市场扩张或结构性转型（战争）时期——保守力量（男性和女性）便会涌现，构建起规范、排斥和限制女性的制度。法律、习俗、专业化和道德话语转而成为经济秩序化的积极机制，导致女性的排斥，最终造成伤害。学术读者可能会在某些地方感到不快。贝特曼对经济活动的处理可被视为将财富、地位、能动性、领导力、智力才能、生产力、科学知识、管理能力和企业家精神混为一谈，归入“经济权力”这一单一类别。这种混同有时削弱了论证的解释力。对专家而言，这可能令人沮丧。然而，将其轻视为面向大众的通俗读物，可能会错失贯穿其中的更深层论点。《经济学》表明，女性的排斥不仅是“父权制”的遗产，更是经济和技术发展所催生的制度变迁过程的反复出现的结果。如果希拉·奥格尔维的关注点在于旧制度具有排斥性和歧视性，那么《经济学》的启示则是，我们也需要关注新制度。尽管贝特曼试图论证社会应支持女性的经济活动，并在书末提出了十点女性赋权宣言，《经济学》也指向了自身之外。增长、技术变革与经济制度的性别化设计之间的关系仍未得到充分理论化。所涌现的制度之间的相似性或差异性、它们服务于谁的利益，以及它们如何在扩张与颠覆的周期中演变，仍是待完成的工作。贝特曼并未解决这些问题，但她将它们坚定地提上了议程。正因如此，也因学生们可能会喜爱这本书，《经济学》是一本经济历史学家应当接纳并可能列入阅读书目的著作。

title: Can teaching children about the environment influence household behavior? Experiments in Swedish schools
title_zh: 教授儿童环境知识能否影响家庭行为？瑞典学校的实验
title_primary: 教授儿童环境知识能否影响家庭行为？瑞典学校的实验
title_secondary: Can teaching children about the environment influence household behavior? Experiments in Swedish schools
authors: Claes Ek, Magnus Söderberg, Mitesh Kataria
official: 官方在线 2026-03-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: In two separate field experiments with Swedish school children aged 10–16, we evaluate Environmental Education Programs designed to promote pro-environmental behavior; specifically, reduce household waste. We match the addresses of participating students with high-resolution administrative records on collected household waste. This allows us to estimate causal effects on the waste generated in households where a child was treated. Across both experiments, we find no detectable reductions in household waste. In the second experiment, we are also able to estimate the effect of regular environmental education within the Swedish school curriculum, and find little indication that this affects household waste.
abstract_zh: 在针对瑞典10至16岁学龄儿童开展的两项独立实地实验中，我们评估了旨在促进亲环境行为、特别是减少家庭废弃物的环境教育项目。我们将参与学生的住址与高分辨率行政记录中收集的家庭废弃物数据进行匹配，从而能够估计儿童接受干预后对其家庭产生废弃物量的因果效应。在两项实验中，我们均未发现家庭废弃物有可检测的减少。在第二项实验中，我们还能估计瑞典学校课程中常规环境教育的影响，并发现几乎没有迹象表明这会影响家庭废弃物。
